welcome.title: Train with a plan that
welcome.body: Answer a few questions. You get a weekly training plan, a meal plan and a log, all stored on this device. No account needed.

days.title: How many days a week can you
days.hint: Pick a number you can keep for months, not just this week.

about.title: About
about.hint: Used to estimate your daily calories. Stored only on this device.
about.errHeight: Enter a height between 120 and 230 cm.
about.errWeight: Enter a weight between 30 and 300 kg.

steps.title: How many steps a
steps.hint: Your current daily average, from your phone or watch. Leave empty if you don't know. Used for your steps target.
steps.label: Average daily steps
steps.err: Enter a number between 0 and 50,000, or leave it empty.

injuries.title: Any areas to
injuries.hint: Exercises that load the area you pick are left out of your plan. Pick none if nothing hurts.
injuries.disclaimer: This filter is not medical advice. Stop any exercise that causes sharp pain.

health.title: Before you
health.question: Do you have any of the following?

items.joint: A bone or joint problem that exercise makes worse

health.warnTitle: Talk to a doctor before starting
health.warnBody: Show this plan to your doctor and ask which parts are safe for you.
health.ack: I understand and will check with a doctor before training.

edit.title: Save profile changes?
edit.training: Your training plan will be regenerated. Exercise swaps you made that still fit your new settings are kept.

home.backupBody: Your last export was more than 14 days ago. Data lives only in this browser.
home.backupNever: You have not exported your data yet. Data lives only in this browser.

home.queueNote: Sessions run in order. If you miss a day, the next session waits for you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataHint: Everything is stored in this browser only. Export a backup file regularly.
settings.importIntro: Choose how to import. Replace all overwrites everything on this device. Merge keeps both and, for records that exist in both, keeps the one edited most recently.
settings.profileWillChange: Your profile will change to the one in the file.

importErrors.notJson: This file is not valid JSON.
importErrors.notExport: This file is not a Gym Plan export.
importErrors.newerVersion: This file comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
importErrors.badRecord: Some records in the file are damaged (missing id or date).

settings.clearBody: This deletes your profile, plan and every log on this device. It cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you want to keep anything.

plan.rampNote: Ramp-up sets build up to the working weight. They count toward session time, not weekly sets.

empty.injury: {slot}: left empty. Every option loads an area you asked to avoid.
empty.equipment: {slot}: left empty. No option fits your equipment.
empty.level: {slot}: left empty. The options are above your current level.
empty.duplicate: {slot}: left empty. The only options are already in this session.

dropped.volume: Left out because those muscles already reach the top of your weekly range: {list}.

plan.swapIntro: Options that train the same muscles and fit your equipment, level and filters.
plan.swapNone: No other exercise fits this slot.

week.steps: Daily steps target: {n} (your average {base} plus 2,000, at most 10,000).
week.stepsUnknown: Daily steps target: your current average plus 2,000, up to 10,000. Add your average in Settings to get a number.
week.editIntro: Pick a day for each session. Sessions run in order, so a missed day never skips a session.
week.clash: Two sessions are on the same day. Pick a different day for one of them.

coverage.intro: Weekly working sets per muscle group against your goal range of {lo}–{hi}. A set counts 1 for the main muscles and 0.5 for helping muscles. Warm-up and ramp-up sets do not count.
coverage.mapLabel: Body map of weekly sets per muscle group. Details are in the table below.
coverage.legend: Hatched: under target. Solid dark: in range. Solid red: over range.
coverage.none: No exercise in the plan trains this group.

warn.beginnerTitle: {days} days is a lot for a beginner
warn.beginnerBody: In the first months, muscles and joints need time between sessions to adapt. A 4-day plan trains each muscle twice a week with more rest.
warn.bwStrength: Maximal strength needs external load. With bodyweight only, this plan builds strength-endurance and skill.
warn.rirBeginner: RIR (reps in reserve: how many more reps you could still do) is hard to judge in the first months. If unsure, stop when the reps slow down clearly.
warn.pplOnce: With Push / Pull / Legs on 3 days, each muscle is trained once a week instead of three times.
warn.swapDropped: One of your swaps no longer fits your settings, so the plan uses its default choice there.

deload.offerEight: You have trained 8 weeks or more without a deload. A deload week keeps the same exercises and loads, halves the sets and stops at RIR 4 or more.
deload.offerDrop: Your estimated 1RM on {name} dropped in 2 sessions in a row. Check sleep and food first; if both are fine, take a deload week.
deload.active: Deload week: half the sets, same loads, stop at RIR 4 or more. Ends {date}.

why.title: Why this plan

split.full-body-2: With 2 days, each session trains every major muscle group, so each muscle still gets practice twice a week.
split.full-body-3: With 3 days, three full-body sessions train each muscle three times a week with different exercises. Frequent practice is the fastest way to learn the lifts.
split.ppl-3: You chose Push / Pull / Legs: one day for pushing muscles, one for pulling muscles, one for legs. Each muscle is trained once a week, with more sets in that session.
split.upper-lower: With 4 days, upper and lower body alternate. Each muscle is trained twice a week and gets two or three days to recover in between.
split.ul-ppl: With 5 days, an upper/lower pair is followed by push, pull and legs. Each muscle is trained twice a week.
split.ppl-6: With 6 days, push, pull and legs run twice. Each muscle is trained twice a week, and each session stays focused on a few muscles.

why.reps: Main lifts use {mlo}–{mhi} reps and accessories {alo}–{ahi} reps. {goalWhy}
why.bodyweightReps: Bodyweight and band exercises use 8–20 reps; when every set reaches 20, you move to a harder version.

goal.build-muscle: Moderate reps taken close to failure give the most growth per set.
goal.lose-fat: Lifting heavy enough while eating less tells your body to keep its muscle, so the weight you lose is mostly fat.
goal.recomposition: The same rep ranges as muscle building keep the training signal high while you eat slightly under maintenance.
goal.get-stronger: Low reps with long rests let you lift heavy loads, which is what builds maximal strength.
goal.general-fitness: Moderate reps with short rests train strength and stamina in the same session.

why.beginnerStrength: As a beginner, your main lifts use 5–8 reps while you learn the technique.
why.volume: Your target is {target} working sets per muscle group per week, inside the {lo}–{hi} range for your goal. {levelWhy}

level.beginner: Beginners start at the bottom of the range: fewer sets are enough to grow at first.
level.intermediate: Intermediate lifters sit in the middle of the range.
level.advanced: Advanced lifters need more sets to keep progressing, so the target is near the top.

why.rir: Most sets stop {lo}–{hi} reps before failure (RIR {lo}–{hi}).
why.time: Each session fits {min} minutes. A working set is counted as 40 s plus its rest, plus {wu} min warm-up, ramp-up sets and {cd} min cool-down. When time runs short, accessories are cut first; the main lift always stays.
why.allInRange: Every muscle group reaches your weekly range.
why.underTime: Under the range because of the time limit: {groups}.
why.closesBoth: One more training day or 15 more minutes per session would close the gap.
why.closesDay: One more training day would close the gap.
why.closesMinutes: 15 more minutes per session would close the gap.
why.closesNeither: Even one more day or 15 more minutes would not fully close the gap with your equipment and filters.
why.underEquipment: No exercise is available for: {groups}. Adding equipment (for example resistance bands) in your profile would let the plan train them.
why.floor: Every major muscle group gets at least 4 sets a week, even when time is short.
why.injuries: Exercises that load {areas} are left out. Slots with no suitable option are left empty and marked.

cardio.build-muscle: One optional light cardio session keeps your heart fit without eating into recovery.
cardio.lose-fat: Three cardio sessions and a daily steps target raise the calories you burn. They go on rest days first so lifting stays strong.
cardio.recomposition: Two light cardio sessions add a little calorie burn without slowing recovery.
cardio.get-stronger: One optional light cardio session supports recovery between heavy days.
cardio.general-fitness: Three cardio sessions a week train the heart and lungs alongside strength.

why.underOptions: Under the range: few exercises fit your equipment and filters, and adding sets to them would pass their set limit or push another muscle group past the top of your range: {groups}. Swapping in another exercise or adding equipment in your profile would help.

buildsFallback.injury: Built around {main} today, because the usual main lift loads an area you asked to avoid. Trains: {groups}.
buildsFallback.options: Built around {main} today, the closest main lift for your equipment and level. Trains: {groups}.

library.title: Exercise
library.fitsMeHint: Uses your equipment, level and areas to avoid from your profile.

exercise.tempo: Tempo: 2 s down, 1 s up, 0.5 s pause.
exercise.holdNote: Hold this position for the time in your plan.
exercise.reduced: Animation is off because your device asks for reduced motion. The figure shows the start and end positions.
exercise.growthNote: Muscles grow when sets end close to failure, the load or reps rise over time, you eat enough protein and you sleep enough. Training without all four gives little visible change.
exercise.tapHint: Tap a muscle on the figure or in the list to see what it does in daily life.
exercise.mapLabel: Body map: main muscles solid, helping muscles hatched
exercise.swapBody: Your plan uses {from} in: {sessions}. Those slots will use {to} instead. You can switch back on the plan page.
exercise.cannotDo: Needs other equipment, a higher level, or loads an area you avoid.
exercise.noHistory: No sets logged yet. Logged sessions appear here once session mode is built (phase 6).

session.intro: Sessions run in order. The timer, sets and rest survive a reload or a locked phone.
session.noPlan: Set up your profile first to get a plan.
session.endBody: Save keeps every logged set and moves your queue to the next session. Discard deletes this session; your queue stays where it is.
session.firstTime: Start light: pick a weight you could lift for about 5 more reps than the target, then adjust on the next set.
session.firstTimeBw: First time: do the reps you can with good form. What you log becomes your baseline.
session.increase: Last time every set reached the top of the range. Load goes up to {kg} kg.
session.extend: Same load, aim for up to {hi} reps first: the next dumbbell jump is more than 10%.
session.addReps: Same load as last time; add a rep where you can.
session.harder: You reached the top of the range. Time to move on to {name}.
session.slow: You reached the top of the range. Add a 3-second lowering phase to every rep.
session.rampNote: Light build-up sets. They do not count toward your weekly sets.
session.swapIntro: Your plan does not change. Pick an exercise that trains the same muscles.
session.restOver: Rest over. Next set when you are ready.
session.deload: Deload week: half the sets, stop at RIR 4 or more.
session.wakeLock: Screen stays on during the session.

summary.title: Session
summary.noPrs: No new records today. Logged sets become the baseline for next time.

nutrition.title: Eat for
nutrition.headTargets: {kcal} kcal · {protein} g protein · {carbs} g carbs · {fat} g fat
nutrition.aboutLink: General guidance, not medical advice. Who this is not for

disclaimer.title: Before you
disclaimer.body: The calorie and meal suggestions here are general guidance, not medical advice. They are not intended for:
disclaimer.pregnant: People who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
disclaimer.eating: People with a current or past eating disorder.
disclaimer.medical: People with a medical condition, including diabetes treated with medication, unless a doctor or dietitian guides them.
disclaimer.estimates: Every number is an estimate. Energy needs differ by about 10% between people of the same size, and food values differ by brand and cooking. Your weight trend over 2 weeks tells you more than any formula.
disclaimer.tick: I have read this, and none of the above applies to me or I have professional guidance.

guard.title: Safety limit applied.
guard.under18: You are under 18, so the app does not set a calorie deficit. The target is your maintenance calories. Talk to a doctor or dietitian before trying to lose weight.
guard.lowBmi: Your BMI is {bmi}, under 18.5, so the app does not set a calorie deficit. The target is your maintenance calories.
guard.bmrFloor: The planned target ({wanted} kcal) was below your BMR ({bmr} kcal), the energy your body uses at rest. The target is raised to your BMR, which makes the deficit smaller: {pct}% instead of the planned value.

macros.fatLowered: Carbs would fall under 100 g, so fat was lowered from {from} to {to} g per kg.
macros.proteinLowered: Carbs would still fall under 100 g, so protein was lowered from {from} to {to} g per kg.
macros.carbsLow: Carbs are {carbs} g, under 100 g, even with fat and protein at their lowest. The calorie target is very low for your body size.

trend.fastLoss: Your 7-day average weight fell {a}% and then {b}% of body weight in the last two weeks. Losing more than 1% a week makes it harder to keep muscle. Check sleep and food first, then consider eating a little more.
trend.calibrate: After {n} weigh-ins in 14 days, your weight changes about {actual} kg a week; the target predicts {expected} kg a week. Your real energy needs are probably different from the estimate.
trend.profileWeight: Your last weigh-in ({kg} kg on {date}) is 2 kg or more away from your profile weight ({profile} kg). The targets use the profile weight.

nutrition.dayOff: This day cannot reach your targets with the foods your filters allow ({kcal} kcal, {protein} g protein). Try another day, swap a food, or relax a filter.

fallback.cap: Your protein target needs more than 300 g of a protein food in one meal with these foods, so it is lowered from {from} g to {to} g (1.6 g per kg) for this day.
fallback.kcal: With the foods your filters allow, {from} g of protein does not fit in your calories, so protein is lowered to {to} g (1.6 g per kg) for this day.

nutrition.missing: {n} item(s) have no allowed replacement and were left out.
nutrition.dayFacts: {veg} g vegetables · {fruit} fruit portions · {fiber} g fiber · about {price} (estimate)

weigh.title: Weigh-in
weigh.label: Weight today
weigh.hint: Weigh in the morning, after the toilet, before eating. Daily numbers jump by 1 kg or more; the 7-day average is what counts.

nutrition.prepChanged: A food in this meal was replaced; cook it the same way as the original or as you usually do.
nutrition.swapIntro: Foods with similar macros to {food}. The portions are recalculated to keep your targets.
nutrition.per100: per 100 g: {kcal} kcal · P {p} · C {c} · F {f} · {price}
nutrition.noAlternatives: No other food fits this slot with your filters.
nutrition.weekIntro: Your goal has {n} daily menus. They rotate by date, so two days in a row never repeat. Tap a day to see its meals.
nutrition.weekTolerance: Each day aims for {kcal} kcal (within 5%) and {protein} g protein (within 10 g). A warning icon marks a day outside that range.

calc.tdeeFormula: {bmr} × {factor} = {tdee} kcal. This is an estimate, about ±10%: {lo}–{hi} kcal.
calc.sliderDefault: Default for your goal: {pct}%. This slider is the only manual control.
calc.sliderLocked: Locked at maintenance by the safety limit above.
calc.offset: Includes {kcal} kcal from a change you accepted after a weight check.
calc.bmi25: Your BMI is {bmi}, over 30, so protein and fat use the weight at BMI 25 for your height: {w} kg.
calc.proteinDeficit: 2.2 g per kg in a calorie deficit, to help keep muscle.
calc.proteinDefault: 1.8 g per kg is the default.
calc.ranges: Ranges used: protein 1.6–2.2 g per kg, fat 0.6–1.0 g per kg (never under 0.5), carbs at least 100 g. 1 g protein or carbs = 4 kcal, 1 g fat = 9 kcal.

filters.title: Food filters
filters.hint: Meals swap a removed food for the closest allowed food, then recalculate portions.
filters.neverNone: No hidden foods. Use "Never show" in a swap to hide one.

progress.title: Your
progress.empty: Nothing logged yet. Finish a session or log one by hand and it shows here.

adherence.title: Sessions per week
adherence.desc: Logged sessions in each of the last 8 weeks against the {days} planned.
adherence.note: * is the current week. The streak counts weeks in a row with every planned session logged.

heatmap.title: Training days
heatmap.desc: The last 16 weeks, one column per week, Monday at the top. {n} training days.

pr.title: Personal records
pr.none: No records yet. Your first log of an exercise sets the baseline; beating it later counts as a record.

weight.title: Body weight
weight.desc: {n} weigh-ins. First {first} kg, latest {last} kg, current 7-day average {avg} kg.
weight.label: Weight
weight.none: No weigh-ins yet. Log one below; the 7-day average line appears from the first entry.

meas.title: Measurements
meas.desc: {n} measurement entries for waist, chest and upper arm.
meas.hint: Waist at the navel, chest at the nipples, arm at the widest point, relaxed. Measure every 2-4 weeks at the same time of day.

lifts.title: Estimated 1RM
lifts.desc: {n} sessions. Best estimated one-rep max per session, first {first} kg, latest {last} kg.
lifts.note: Estimated from your best set of 1-10 reps each session (Epley: load × (1 + reps ÷ 30)). It shows the trend; it is not a lift to attempt.
lifts.none: Log a weighted exercise to see its estimated 1RM trend.

sets.title: Weekly sets per muscle group
sets.desc: Working sets logged this week per muscle group against the sets in your plan. Goal range: {lo}-{hi} sets.
sets.note: Same counting rule as the plan: 1 per set for the main muscles, 0.5 for helper muscles. Warm-up and ramp-up sets do not count. Your goal's range is {lo}-{hi} sets a week.

meals.title: Meal plan check-off
meals.question: Did you follow the meal plan on {date}?
meals.adherence: Followed on {n} of the last {total} days you checked.

edit.errEmpty: Add at least one exercise with a set of 1 or more reps.
edit.errDate: Pick a date that is today or earlier.

progress.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Export your data first if you may want it back.
